author: StreamCurves regional analysis (STAF)
revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 10 of 13 stations of this ecoregion pass. 4 reference curves use local stations, 16 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 6 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support.
sourceCitation: USEPA NRSA 2013-24 (L3 ecoregion 77), StreamCurves regional analysis, methodology 0.16-provisional
